question: The POSHAN Abhiyaan launched in 2018 focuses on the nutritional status of adolescent girls, pregnant women, lactating mothers and children of which age group?
solution:
The correct answer is **__0-6 years__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Poshan Abhiyaan is the flagship program to improve nutritional outcomes for children, pregnant women, and lactating mothers in India. It is also called the National Nutrition Mission.
 
• The program was launched on International Women’s Day on 8 March 2018 at Jhunjhunu in Rajasthan.
 
• The Poshan Abhiyaan spreads awareness towards the problems pertaining to malnutrition and brings viable solutions with it.
 
• The Rashtriya Poshan Abhiyan or National Nutrition Mission is administered under the government’s Ministry of Women and Child Development.
 
• The National Nutrition Mission commenced with a three-year budget of Rs. 9046.17 Crore in 2017-18.
 
• The prime target of the mission was to annually reduce stunting, malnutrition, anemia, and low birth weight by 2%, 2%, 3%, and 2%, respectively, among children, adolescent girls, women, and lactating mothers.
 
• For children, the most crucial period considered by the program is the first 1,000 days, including the nine months of pregnancy and the child's first two years of life. This is because this period is considered crucial for a child's physical and mental development.
 
• The Abhiyaan also focuses on addressing undernutrition and stunting among children under five years of age.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The POSHAN (Prime Minister’s Overarching Scheme for Holistic Nutrition) Abhiyan directs the attention of the country towards the problem of malnutrition.
 
• The government is implementing POSHAN Abhiyaan, earlier known as National Nutrition Mission.
